note: Recorded through the MCP connector, not the REST route. The REST GET /agents/:id shape is asserted by docs/clawpump-integration.md (verified live 2026-09-17/18) but no REST body was recorded field-by-field. The client schema therefore types only id, user_id, name, status, wallet_address and passes the rest through, and accepts both a bare object and an {agent: ...} wrapper. The `config` object (persona and system prompt text) was removed: it is not read by ClawVille.
